gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-encode-sans-semi-: Chunky and cheerful, Comic Relief leaves its bowls unfinished on one side and hums along in a soft, featureless texture. Encode Sans Semi Condensed keeps the s open beneath it.

gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 gives the body clean curves with plenty of daylight inside them. And Comic Relief is the showoff, its horizontals just as thick as its verticals, which Exo 2 is happy to let it be.

gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-fahkwang: Comic Relief has curves as thick as its straight stems, with bowls left unfinished on one side, which makes it feel bold and a bit cheeky. Fahkwang's body text can stay at its usual size.
